name: Purine ribonucleoside catabolism via inosine
rationale: AMP/IMP/inosine catabolism, ADA and PNP defects and allantoin formation all describe ribonucleoside purine breakdown, unlike the deoxyribonucleotide and salvage confusables.

name: Ureteric bud formation and branching
rationale: All members concern formation or branching regulation of the ureteric bud, whereas confusables cover nephric duct, nephron and ureter morphogenesis.

name: Androgen and estrogen receptor transcriptional responses
rationale: Members are androgen, estrogen and progesterone receptor responses with prominent androgen/AR gene sets, which the estrogen-late, HSP90 chaperone and GPER1 confusables lack.

qualifier: with microtubule severing and organelle size control
name: Microtubule organelle transport, severing and endolysosome size control
rationale: Members cover microtubule-dependent organelle and mitochondrial transport plus microtubule severing/depolymerization and endosome/lysosome size, unlike confusables centred on neuronal cargo, kinesins and ER network shaping.

name: Nuclear receptor control of lipid metabolism and mitochondrial biogenesis
rationale: LXR, PPARA, ROR/REV-ERB, PGC-1alpha and circadian nuclear receptor members regulate lipid and energy metabolism genes, distinct from adipogenesis, SREBP/ChREBP and purely circadian confusables.

qualifier: cytochrome P450 substrates with ichthyosis defects
name: Cytochrome P450 fatty acid metabolism with ichthyosis defects
rationale: Members are P450 fatty acid/eicosanoid substrate sets, linoleate metabolism and SLC27A4/CYP4F22 ichthyoses, unlike confusables focused on HETE/EET synthesis, hepoxilins or cornified envelope.

name: Striated muscle cell proliferation, differentiation and regeneration
rationale: Members regulate skeletal and cardiac myoblast proliferation, differentiation, fusion and regeneration, unlike confusables on muscle atrophy or calcineurin-driven cardiac hypertrophy.

qualifier: positive regulation of respiration and ATP synthesis
name: Stimulation of mitochondrial respiration and ATP synthesis
rationale: Members positively regulate respiration, electron transport, ATP and nucleotide synthesis alongside hypoxia/oxidative-stress responses, whereas confusables carry negative regulation of respiration and ROS.

name: Mammary and prostate gland epithelial development
rationale: All members concern mammary or prostate gland branching, epithelial differentiation and lactation, unlike genital tract, placental and lung-branching confusables.

name: Stress-induced senescence and CDKN2A (p16/p14ARF) defects
rationale: Members cover oncogene- and oxidative-stress-induced senescence, SASP, polycomb control and p16INK4A/p14ARF evasion defects, unlike p53/p21 and SAHF/replicative senescence confusables.

name: Adrenergic control of cardiac contraction and insulin secretion
rationale: Members are epinephrine/norepinephrine responses regulating heart force, rate and insulin secretion and catecholamine release, unlike confusables centred on adenylate-cyclase-inhibitory and smooth muscle signaling.

name: Notch O-glycosylation by fucose and glucose in somitogenesis
rationale: Members are O-fucosylation/O-glucosylation of Notch and TSR proteins, LFNG/B3GALTL defects and somite patterning, unlike N-glycan, Hedgehog lipidation and heparan sulfate confusables.

name: Hepatic gluconeogenesis, glucose-6-phosphatase and fructose metabolism
rationale: Members cover gluconeogenesis, G6PC/SLC37A4 deficiencies, glucokinase regulation and fructose/alanine metabolism, unlike glycolysis, glycogenolysis and glycogen synthesis confusables.

qualifier: cytosolic calcium removal by SERCA and Na+/Ca2+ exchange
name: Cardiac cytosolic calcium removal by SERCA and Na/Ca exchange
rationale: Members concern SR calcium reuptake, Na/Ca exchangers and cardiac relaxation, whereas confusables emphasise calcium release, ryanodine receptors and store-operated entry.

name: Nitric oxide-cGMP signaling regulating renal sodium and water excretion
rationale: Members are NO/cGMP signaling with natriuresis, urine volume and glomerular filtration, unlike confusables on eNOS activation and vascular blood pressure control.

name: Axon guidance by semaphorin-3A and netrin repulsion
rationale: Members cover axon guidance and extension with Sema3A/CRMP and netrin repulsive signaling, unlike confusables on monoaminergic neuron guidance and collateral sprouting.

name: Two-pore-domain potassium channels in pain and thermosensation
rationale: Members are K2P channel families (TWIK, TREK, TASK, TALK, THIK, TRESK) with pain, itch and temperature sensing, unlike TRP, taste/olfaction and Ca-activated K+ confusables.

name: Centriole duplication, basal body docking and cilium assembly control
rationale: Members concern centriole duplication/elongation, basal body anchoring and regulation of cilium assembly/disassembly, unlike intraflagellar transport and centrosome positioning confusables.

name: Ascorbate metabolism and vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation
rationale: Members cover ascorbate/dehydroascorbate metabolism and vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation of proteins, unlike vitamin K catabolism, ROS detoxification and BH4 confusables.

name: Store-operated calcium entry and cytosolic calcium elevation
rationale: Members concern SOCE activation, release of sequestered calcium and calcium sensing, whereas confusables cover calcium removal and Na/Ca exchange.

name: Tricarboxylic acid cycle and malate-aspartate shuttle
rationale: Members cover TCA intermediates, pyruvate, malate-aspartate shuttle and respiratory coupling, unlike confusables on PDH/CoA synthesis, isocitrate/NADPH or glutamate nitrogen metabolism.

qualifier: centrosome separation by PLK1 and NEK kinases
name: Centrosome separation and spindle assembly by PLK1-NEK kinases
rationale: Members cover NEK6/7/9 and PLK1 activity, centrosome separation and spindle formation, unlike spindle checkpoint and AURKA confusables.

name: Epidermal keratinization and ectodermal appendage development
rationale: Members cover keratinocyte differentiation, cornification and hair, tooth, nail and gland development, unlike melanocyte MITF and intestinal epithelium confusables.

name: Cerebellar cortex development and motor coordination
rationale: Members concern cerebellar layer formation, granule precursors, Bergmann glia and locomotor/motor learning behavior, unlike hindbrain/brainstem and forebrain confusables.

qualifier: immediate-early AP-1 induction and negative feedback
name: Immediate-early AP-1 induction and MAPK negative feedback
rationale: Members cover AP-1/NR4A immediate-early genes, ERK inactivation and MAPK feedback, unlike confusables on ERK activation, IL-6 and KRAS signaling.
